name: South Australian State Dance Sport (SASDS)
notes: Annual eisteddfod at Westminster School, Marion. Key dates also appear in Buzz e-news.

name: Dance Competitions SA
notes: Mason family comps, typically June and September. Site is brochure-style; confirm dates with the organiser.

name: Evolution Dance Comp
notes: National tour plus January Gold Coast finals. City pages have entry close times.

name: Count Me In Dance Competition (CMIDC)
notes: Golden Grove and Goolwa seasons. Enter via cmidc.com.au/enter-now.

name: Dance Hub Australia — NSW
notes: Aggregator calendar. Always confirm on the organiser site before entering.

name: Dance Hub Australia — Queensland
notes: Aggregator calendar for QLD events.

name: Dance Hub Australia — Victoria
notes: Aggregator calendar for VIC events.

name: Follow Your Dreams
notes: Running sheets and entries at fydentry.com.

name: Carnival Dance Challenge
notes: Adelaide solos and troupes plus interstate events.

name: dancetrain magazine — Competitions & Events
notes: National listings useful as a cross-check, especially SA dates.

name: Full Out
notes: Australian Full Out regionals and state finals. Listings and CompHQ entry links come from fullout.com.au/enter/ only (tour dates image at fullout.com.au/tour-dates/). Waitlist: dance@fullout.com.au.

name: Get the Beat
notes: GTB (Get the Beat) Australian solo tour at gtbdance.com/2027, plus finals dates on gtbdance.com/entries. Asia dates on gtbasia.com are not listed.

name: Raise the Barre
notes: Perth and Adelaide dance festival. The 2026 calendar on the events page is an image; seed rows hold those dates until the page publishes them as text. Registration is on MyCompHQ.

name: Supreme Dance Experience
notes: Commercial dance tour from the Get the Beat team. The 2026 tour page lists Adelaide and Sydney.

name: CanDance Australia
notes: South Australian competition. July page has dates; the October page names Golden Grove and Kent Town but does not publish a day range.

name: Pendulum Dance Competitions
notes: Adelaide competition, usually at Shedley Theatre, Elizabeth. The site often answers with a bot check. 2027 dates were not published when this source was added.

name: Showcase
notes: Showcase Australian Dance Championships. Qualifier dates are partner logos, not a text calendar. The schedule table plus the Finals Jan page supply the Gold Coast nationals.

name: DanceLife Unite
notes: Regional and national dates from the MyCompHQ event index. Performer links are the registration URLs. National cards on that index do not name a city.

name: Talent Tribe
notes: National finals save-the-date on the homepage. The 2026/27 tour page lists entry closing dates without performance dates or venues, so those stops are skipped.

name: Jump Dance Challenge
notes: Season nationals from the nationals page. 2027 heat dates on /heats are images, so they are not scraped until published as text. Registration portals are on CompAdminPro.

name: Time to Shine
notes: Live events and entry close dates from the organiser's Comps-Online list. Events with no venue are skipped so they are not filed under the wrong state.
